name: Pixies

whyMatters.en: Boston four-piece whose Surfer Rosa/Doolittle quiet-loud song forms became the template Nirvana and 90s alternative copied.
whyMatters.zh: 波士顿四人组：Surfer Rosa/Doolittle 的强弱曲式成为 Nirvana 与 90 年代 alternative 复制的模板。

note.en: Surfer Rosa; clean arpeggio then scream lift.
note.zh: Surfer Rosa；干净分解后尖叫抬升。
Doolittle 开场；强弱强教科书。

note.en: Deal lead vocal; bass hook as A-side face.
note.zh: Deal 主唱；贝斯钩子当 A 面脸。

interviewQuotes.text: We were trying to be the next Husker Du and failed into something better.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Black Francis

lyricQuotes: With your feet on the air and your head on the ground
Got me a movie / I want you to know

shortBio.en: Quiet-loud alternative; Surfer Rosa/Doolittle template Nirvana cited.
shortBio.zh: 强弱 alternative；Nirvana 引用的 Surfer Rosa/Doolittle 模板。

body.en:
Formed 1986. Albini on Surfer Rosa; Gil Norton on Doolittle. Soft-loud dynamics, surreal lyric, Santiago lead noise. Split 1993; reunions from 2004.

Noise and shoegaze textures appear in guitar spray, but song form stays verse-scream-hook—genre slug stays alternative/indie.
body.zh:
1986 年组建。Surfer Rosa 找 Albini；Doolittle 找 Gil Norton。强弱动态、超现实歌词、Santiago 噪音主音。1993 解散；2004 起重聚。

吉他喷雾里有噪音与 shoegaze 纹理，但曲式仍是主歌-尖叫-钩子——类型 slug 仍是 alternative/indie。

body.en:
Pixies invent (or crystallize) soft verse / screamed chorus for college radio. Surreal titles, short runtimes, no prog padding.

Nirvana openly copies the dynamic map on Nevermind.
body.zh:
Pixies 发明（或结晶）大学电台的安静主歌/尖叫副歌。超现实标题、短时长、无 prog 填充。

Nirvana 在 Nevermind 上公开复制动态地图。

body.en:
Francis / Deal / Santiago / Lovering is the silhouette. Deal exits reunions later; peak flag stays Doolittle-era four.

No singer swap—method is the four-way balance.
body.zh:
Francis / Deal / Santiago / Lovering 即剪影。Deal 后离开重聚；巅峰旗留在 Doolittle 时期四人。

无主唱替换——方法是四方平衡。

title.zh: 尖叫、和声贝斯、冲浪噪音主音

body.en:
Francis: Tele bark and Spanish blurt. Deal: melodic bass + Gigantic lead. Santiago: surf-twang into noise. Lovering: dry punch kit.

Albini/Gil Norton capture rooms differently; form stays.
body.zh:
Francis：Tele 吠叫与西语爆发。Deal：旋律贝斯 + Gigantic 主唱。Santiago：冲浪颤音进噪音。Lovering：干、砸的鼓。

Albini/Gil Norton 抓房间不同；曲式不变。

title.en: Where Is My Mind?: soft entry

body.en:
Arpeggio hook, Deal harmony, controlled lift—not full scream wall. Film sync later expands reach.

Surfer Rosa face that still teaches dynamics.
body.zh:
分解钩子、Deal 和声、受控抬升——非全尖叫墙。后来影视同步扩大触及。

仍教动态的 Surfer Rosa 脸。

body.en:
Doolittle opener. Bass start, scream chorus, Bunuel lyric joke. College-radio violence with pop length.

Primary teaching object for 90s alt dynamics.
body.zh:
Doolittle 开场。贝斯起、尖叫副歌、布努埃尔歌词玩笑。流行长度的大学电台暴力。

90 年代 alt 动态的主教学对象。

title.zh: Grunge 与 indie 的模板

body.en:
Cobain cites Pixies dynamics. Radiohead and Strokes pull angular hooks. Noise/shoegaze neighbors (Sonic Youth, MBV) share guitar abrasion; Pixies keep songs shorter.

Boston four as 90s alt operating system.
body.zh:
Cobain 引用 Pixies 动态。Radiohead 与 Strokes 抽棱角钩子。噪音/shoegaze 邻里（Sonic Youth、MBV）共享吉他磨损；Pixies 把歌唱得更短。

波士顿四人组作为 90 年代 alt 操作系统。

note.en: Quiet-loud single that became 90s alt grammar.
note.zh: 成为 90 年代 alt 语法的强弱单曲。

note.en: Soft-loud song form export; noise color inside indie length.
note.zh: 强弱曲式输出；indie 长度里的噪音色彩。
